videos.title: I Tried Astro Build and I LOVE IT - 5 Reasons You Will TOO!
videos.description:
The Astro framework has some amazing features you'll want to check out. I recently tried Astro for the first time, and I absolutely love it. Let's walk through my 5 favorite features that I love about it. I think you'll love them too!
